mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, title, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM chat_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id AS userId, title, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM chat_session WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_session SET title = #{title} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE chat_session SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
